description: Members are sorted by UTF-16 code units, not code points: U+1F600 (the surrogates 0xD83D 0xDE00) sorts before U+FB01 (one unit, 0xFB01) although its code point is larger; capitals sort before lowercase, "a" before "a\u0000", and U+007F after "b". An escaped \u00e9 in the input is written literally, U+007F literally, and U+0000 as \u0000.
